```{r, echo=F}

metrics <- readRDS("../src/novel-discovery/kfold-specific-panel/metrics-fixed.rds")

```

```{r, echo=F}
k <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=_k-).*(?=_boots)")
iter <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=-iter-).*(?=_k-)")
boots <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=_boots-).*(?=_sel-prop)")
filter.val <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=_filter-).*(?=_sel)")
class.val <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=_class-).*(?=)")
meta.data <- metrics$file.name %>% str_extract("(?<=_meta-).*(?=_filter-)")

metrics.up <- metrics
metrics.up$file.name <- NULL
metrics.up <- metrics.up[,-c(5,6,7,8)]
metrics.up$class <- class.val
metrics.up$k <- k
metrics.up$iter <- iter
metrics.up$boots <- boots
metrics.up$filter <- filter.val
metrics.up$meta.data <- meta.data
rownames(metrics.up) <- NULL
metrics.up %>% kbl(format="html", align="c") %>% kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left", bootstrap_options="bordered")

```

# Method

- 10% filtration of RNA, preprocessing is kept the same as in the manuscript.

- Split our parents into 10 folds and 10/50 iterations. (i.e. sibling stratified)
  The splits were conducted such that each fold contained similar number of parents
  who had at least one hcg positive embryo 

- For each fold, use the training folds to conduct feature selection. 
  Feature selection will involve bootstrapping the training data 100 times,
  and then running an L1-logistic regression on each bootstrap. A feature
  that has been selected by any of these bootstraps will be used in the
  predictive model. Hyperparameters: Lambda value is chosen to be the "lambda.1se"
  value. I.e. it is the lambda that results in a cross-validated deviance that 
  is within 1 standard error of the minimum cross-validated deviance.
  
- After selection of the RNA, we optionally add on meta-data that we want to
  include as a predictor.
  
- Train an L2-regularised logistic regression on the training folds, and then
  test on the held-out fold. Hyperparameters: Lambda value is chosen to be the
  "lambda.min" value.
  
- Record the AUC/sens/spec for this iteration, and then repeat.

- Finally, the median metrics for AUC, sens, and spec are reported.
